content.short: RewardMe gives shoppers extra cashback in rewards or crypto at over 100 merchants.
content.description: RewardMe links to a shopper's email receipts and pays up to 5% extra rewards on purchases from more than 100 online and in-store merchants, in Reward Dollars or crypto that can be redeemed for gift cards. It runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: RewardMe pays extra shopping rewards in cash or crypto at 100+ merchants, with a World App mini app.
